headline: Two o'clock. The panes go milky.
body: A cloud has taken the direct light without taking the day. Across the way a sash is half raised and the curtain does not move. The road is louder than the room.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high thin cloud, 14°C, N at 7 mph

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: sash half raised, traffic past the stop

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: glare off the panes, no hard shadow
